title: Synthesis, Binding Affinity Analysis, and (18) F Radiosynthesis of Small-Molecular-Weight HIF-1alpha-Binding Compounds.
authors: Dawn Woodfield, Jenilee; Bhardwaj, Atul; Bergman, Cody; Wuest, Frank
one_liner_zh: 该文合成小分子和环肽并评估其与HIF-1alpha蛋白的结合，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子/肽互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题TF-DNA研究关联弱。
abstract: Eleven small-molecular-weight compounds and three cyclic peptides were synthesized and evaluated for binding to hypoxia-inducible factor-1alpha (HIF-1alpha). Microscale thermophoresis analysis identified peptide [(19) F]SFB-link-c-(Ppg)LLFVY 3 and small-molecule inhibitor 5 as potent HIF-1alpha binding compounds with K(D) values of 0.46+/-0.2 muM and 7.8+/-3.4 muM, respectively. Both compounds represent novel HIF-1alpha-targeting compounds that are predicted to interact with the PAS-B region of HIF-1alpha, as confirmed with molecular docking studies. Lead structures 3 and 5 were further radiolabelled with fluorine-18 for positron emission tomography (PET) imaging agents targeting HIF-1alpha in vivo.
abstract_zh: 合成了十一种小分子量化合物和三种环肽，并评估了它们与缺氧诱导因子-1α（HIF-1alpha）的结合能力。微量热泳动分析鉴定出肽[(19)F]SFB-link-c-(Ppg)LLFVY 3 和小分子抑制剂5为强效HIF-1alpha结合化合物，其K(D)值分别为0.46±0.2 μM和7.8±3.4 μM。这两种化合物均代表新型HIF-1alpha靶向化合物，预测与HIF-1alpha的PAS-B区域相互作用，这一点已通过分子对接研究得到证实。先导结构3和5进一步用氟-18进行放射性标记，用于靶向HIF-1alpha的正电子发射断层扫描（PET）成像剂，以在体内进行应用。
